matches.openingState: Before attacks, fixed eye-level three-quarter wide shot: full-body Bastion left on flippers, Cedar right on four hooves, facing each other 5m apart on the dry center. Channels flank it; crossings are clear. The mint caretaker opens the sluice from the off-court rear verge.

events.strategyQuote: a heavy mouth-fired water hammer aimed at their chest
events.defenderQuote: dodge across the dry raised crossing only after he commits his aim.
events.visibleAction: Bastion jets water 5m from the left toward Cedar's chest line. Cedar moves 1m across the right dry crossing before arrival; the jet splashes her vacated turning line, leaving wet center stone behind her.
events.why: The release-triggered crossing move clears the jet before impact. Its splash wets the abandoned route, not her raised escape strip; water alone deals no damage.

events.strategyQuote: lash a thick green vine from my forehoof into his exposed neck and shoulder
events.defenderQuote: turn my shell toward it and physically brace, then answer with water.
events.visibleAction: From the right crossing lip, Cedar sends a 4.8m vine toward Bastion's neck. He coils his neck, turns his small shell toward it and braces his flippers; the lash glances across shell and shoulder, rocking him left.
events.why: Bastion is free after 1.1 and braces after the reaction minimum. Shell and shoulder physically share the impact, reducing damage to 15.

events.strategyQuote: followed by a second short water hammer after recovery.
events.visibleAction: Bastion slides 1.5m straight along dry center stone while charging, then jets about 3.1m into Cedar's actual chest at the right lip. She recoils; splash wets her rear-hoof area while her forehooves remain on the dry edge.
events.why: The approach stays below 4m/s. Cedar has already committed her repeated lash and is recovering at impact, so neither dodge nor shield is available. Damage is 30.

events.strategyQuote: then repeat the heavy lash after my own recovery.
events.visibleAction: Cedar's already-released vine crosses about 3.1m from the right dry lip and cracks Bastion's exposed neck. His flippers splay and belly scrapes stone; she maintains a straight stance beside the persistent wet patch.
events.why: The earlier water hit is not a knockout and cannot cancel this released lash. Bastion remains in water-hammer recovery until 2.98; the lash deals 30.

events.strategyQuote: Keep tracking and attacking after each recovery;
events.defenderQuote: turn my shell toward it and physically brace, then answer with water.
events.visibleAction: Cedar lashes about 3.1m from the right dry lip without turning through the puddle. Bastion presents his shell and braces; the vine strikes rim and shoulder, his flippers buckle, and his weight drops into a sideways fall.
events.why: The free, reaction-valid brace halves damage to 15, exactly exhausting Bastion's remaining HP. He cannot begin his intended answer after knockout.

matches.continuityAtThree: At 3.0s Bastion has 15HP on the center strip, about 3.1m left of Cedar, and his recovery has ended. Cedar has 30HP on the right dry lip, recovering until 3.15. Both splash patches persist; she has not planted a turn in them.
matches.victoryPose: From 4.31s through 8s, Bastion lies motionless on his side on left-center stone, flippers slack after the fall. Cedar stands separately at the right dry crossing lip, four hooves grounded, not touching him. The fixed wide camera holds.
matches.whyWinner: Cedar finishes with 30HP/19 energy; Bastion with 0HP/50 energy. Her dry-crossing dodge erased 30 damage; vines dealt 15+30+15 despite shell braces. Without that opening dodge, Bastion's two hammers would knock her out before her last lash.

matches.openingState: Before attacks, fixed eye-level three-quarter wide shot: full-body Elrond left with dragon wings unfolded, Zephyr right with feet tucked, facing each other 5m apart at 1.2m above the front channel. Crossings are dry; the mint caretaker opens the sluice off-court at the rear.

events.strategyQuote: a heavy blue pressure orb from my mouth aimed at her chest
events.defenderQuote: dodge laterally when he releases the orb
events.visibleAction: Elrond launches a blue orb 5m from the left at Zephyr's chest. She banks 1m sideways above the channel before arrival; it passes her former position. He follows forward on a shallow airborne curve, clear of the crossings.
events.why: Zephyr reacts after release and moves clear at no more than 4m/s. The open channel airspace contains no cover or obstruction to intercept the orb.

events.strategyQuote: then fire a heavy amber starburst from my forepaws into his side during his recovery.
events.visibleAction: From the right at 1.2m height, Zephyr fires into advancing Elrond's actual side. The star travels about 1.2m as he closes another 0.4m; his torso jolts, but his winding shoulder approach continues.
events.why: Her required windup outlasts his orb recovery. His new shoulder windup nevertheless prevents a dodge; the star deals 30 without cancelling his attack.

events.strategyQuote: drive a wing-assisted shoulder check into her actual flank at matching height
events.visibleAction: Elrond completes roughly 4.8m of curved flight since his orb release and drives his shoulder into Zephyr's real flank at 1.2m height, claws tucked. She tilts and flutters; he passes clear toward the right crossing.
events.why: The 1.22s approach stays below 4m/s and ends in body contact. Zephyr is recovering from her star, so her conditional rise-and-bank is unavailable. Damage is 30.

events.strategyQuote: counter his exposed back with another starburst after recovery.
events.visibleAction: Zephyr fires about 1.2m into Elrond's exposed back as he curves back toward her, closing the gap. His wing stroke folds and his body spins down toward the right dry crossing; she stays airborne to his left.
events.why: Elrond recommitted to a shoulder windup at 2.2 and cannot bank defensively. This 30-damage back hit exhausts his remaining HP before his intended release.

events.strategyQuote: drive a wing-assisted shoulder check into her actual flank at matching height
events.visibleAction: Elrond's unfinished return curve never brings his shoulder to Zephyr. The back impact collapses his windup at 2.61s; he drops toward the right crossing while she holds clear air to his left.
events.why: Knockout occurs before the intended 2.7 release. The full 25 energy is paid, and recovery ends at interruption; no shoulder damage occurs.

matches.continuityAtThree: At 3.0s Elrond has 0HP and is falling and rolling toward his side on the right dry crossing, not recovering. Zephyr has 30HP and remains 1.2m airborne above the channel to his left. No further attack starts; water remains confined.
matches.victoryPose: From 3.26s through 8s, Elrond lies motionless on his side on the right dry crossing, wings slack after the fall. Zephyr hovers separately at 1.2m above the front channel to his left, feet tucked, never holding him. The fixed wide camera holds.
matches.whyWinner: Zephyr finishes with 30HP/44 energy; Elrond with 0HP/25 energy. Her initial bank saved 30HP, and her second star caught his renewed shoulder windup. Without that opening dodge, orb plus first shoulder would knock her out before her second star.

matches.openingState: Before attacks, fixed eye-level three-quarter wide shot: full-body Cedar left on four hooves on reset dry center stone, Zephyr right with feet tucked at 1.2m above the front channel. They face each other 5m apart. Crossings are clear; the mint caretaker opens the sluice off-court.

events.strategyQuote: send one heavy starburst at the torso
events.defenderQuote: wait for its projectile to commit, sidestep on dry stone
events.visibleAction: After a short angle change above the right channel, Zephyr fires about 5.2m toward Cedar's torso. Cedar sidesteps 1m along dry center stone before arrival; the star passes her former position without moving channel water.
events.why: Cedar waits for projectile commitment, then clears its line below 4m/s. Her route is dry, so no shield or footing penalty applies.

events.strategyQuote: whip upward into its real flank as it comes into range.
events.defenderQuote: dodge the real return attack if free before firing again.
events.visibleAction: Cedar steps 1m closer on dry center stone and whips a vine about 4.2m upward. Zephyr rises 0.5m and banks 0.5m clear of the committed flank line before arrival; the vine passes below and beside her, then retracts.
events.why: Zephyr is free after 1.3 and waits for the lash release. Her diagonal displacement stays below 4m/s and within the 2m flight ceiling; it is a real evasion.

events.visibleAction: Zephyr lowers to 1.2m above the right channel and fires about 3.5m into Cedar's actual torso. Cedar's hooves skid slightly on dry stone from the impact, but her already-released second vine continues toward Zephyr.
events.why: Cedar chose another lash at 2.2 and is recovering when the star arrives. She cannot insert a sidestep or shield; the star deals 30.

events.strategyQuote: Keep tracking and attacking after each recovery;
events.visibleAction: From left-center dry stone, Cedar's vine extends about 3.6m into Zephyr's real flank at 1.2m height. Zephyr recoils sideways above the channel but keeps flying; Cedar remains grounded and the vine retracts.
events.why: The torso hit did not knock Cedar out or cancel her released lash. Zephyr is recovering until 3.07, so this tracked contact deals 30.

events.visibleAction: Zephyr glides 1.2m closer above the channel and fires a 2.4m star into Cedar's torso. Cedar's raised forehoof buckles, her weight drops onto the dry center and she begins falling sideways; Zephyr banks clear to the right.
events.why: The approach takes 0.57s, below the movement cap. The short projectile flight reaches Cedar during her third lash windup, dealing her remaining 30HP.

events.strategyQuote: Keep tracking and attacking after each recovery;
events.visibleAction: Cedar's third forehoof vine remains unlaunched when the torso star hits. Her stance folds and she falls onto her side on left-center stone; Zephyr stays airborne above the channel to her right, outside contact.
events.why: Knockout at 3.77 precedes the intended 3.8 release. The attempted lash pays its full 25 energy and ends at interruption without damage.

matches.continuityAtThree: At exactly 3.0s Cedar's second vine strikes Zephyr's flank: both now have 30HP. Cedar is grounded on dry center stone, recovering until 3.3; Zephyr remains 1.2m above the right channel, recovering until 3.07, about 3.6m away. Water is confined.
matches.victoryPose: From 4.17s through 8s, Cedar lies motionless on her side on left-center dry stone, legs relaxed after the fall. Zephyr hovers separately at 1.2m above the right front channel, feet tucked, not touching Cedar. The fixed wide camera holds both bodies.
matches.whyWinner: Zephyr finishes with 30HP/19 energy; Cedar with 0HP/19 energy. Both opening attacks were dodged, but Zephyr's earlier repeat cycle and closer third shot beat Cedar's release. Holding the second lash to sidestep that committed star instead could preserve Cedar's 30HP.
